The structure of Eu3BiO4 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4₁md (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 32 atoms (Eu12Bi4O16) distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Bi centers coordinated by six O neighbors, Eu centers adopting 8- and 12-neighbor environments, and O centers with 6 or 8 geometric neighbors. The neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 32 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Bi and O polyhedra, corner-sharing between O and Eu 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Eu 8- and 12-vertex polyhedra.
